title: Pipeline
subtitle: How this app is configured, end to end.
unavailable: The pipeline view is not available on this server yet.
sr: Three-band flow diagram. Media band: the enabled ingest sources feed the StreamHub core (through the MediaMTX router when enabled), pass through the enabled processing stages (transcoding, adaptive) and fan out to the delivery endpoints, while a passthrough/remux lane bypasses the core. Compute band: Studio Apps and processor plugins analyse the stream, and a distributed edge-compute cluster runs the enabled vision models. Events band: recordings flow to storage and S3, and detections fan out to callbacks, MQTT, the log and the enabled notification channels.

svg.title: Media pipeline
svg.desc: Animated three-band diagram of this app's configured media pipeline: compute (apps, processors, edge models), media (ingest, router, processing, delivery, passthrough) and events (storage, callbacks, notifications).
